$comment: The home's section library. skins/<name>/skin.json lists sections in order, each { section, variant, band? }. 'band' is the default tint (white or the family tint band); 'tone' says whether a skin may flip it. scripts/skin-apply.mjs validates a skin against this file; components/ly/home/LyHome.vue maps each id and variant to its component.

variants.split: The shop's name and line on the left; the counter photo bleeding to the right edge of the frame, a framed inset across the seam with the best seller, the three most-ordered collections set large on the photo's dark corner (from Pralino).
variants.mirror: The same parts mirrored: the photo bleeds to the left edge, the words sit on the right, the collections on the photo's left corner (Domino's hero).

variants.numbers: The shop in numbers (collections, the saving, days and hours, ways to receive an order) beside its story, photo and Delivery / Pickup / Payment links (from Pralino).
variants.story: The story, the photo and the links, centred, without the numbers (pair it with counters; Domino's About).

variants.band: The shop in numbers on the family-dark band, four to a row with thin dividers, the numbers set large in the display face (Domino's cocoa counters, without scallops: one shape language).

variants.rows: The four collections people order most as alternating photo rows: an outlined numeral, the description, three best sellers with prices, 'Shop <collection>' (from Pralino).
variants.cards: The same four as a 2 × 2 grid of cards, the photo on top inside the card (Domino).

variants.photo: How ordering works over a photo bleeding to the frame's edge: four features from the shop's own facts and the courier's card (from Pralino).

variants.ways: The courier's numbers, the tall offer card on its photo and every way to receive an order (from Pralino).

variants.mosaic: A gallery of the collections around the most-ordered one, product plates where a collection is missing (from Pralino).

variants.rows: Today's selection: six best sellers mixed across collections as numbered rows with one Add button style (from Pralino).

variants.full: A full-width photo band with a scroll-down button (from Pralino).

variants.names: A slow marquee of the collections' names (from Pralino).

variants.photo: The four newest posts beside a tall photo with the big word 'Journal' (from Pralino; best last).

variants.hero: The photo to the frame edges on the stage near-black of the hue, a giant italic condensed line, a sentence, the lead department and All toys (Play Lab).

variants.strip: Departments and a button for each department with products, then All toys, on the wash band (Play Lab).

variants.lineup: The lead department two most-sold toys as wide list cards (Play Lab).

variants.missions: Pick a challenge: three departments as wide tiles with their own image (Play Lab).

variants.feature: The workbench photo beside a tinted panel with a giant italic line and the department button (Play Lab).

variants.row: Four toys of the next department as cards (Play Lab).

variants.levels: Shop by age from the toys own specification, youngest first, in even rows (Play Lab).

variants.compare: The comparison teaser: the lineup two toys side by side and Compare these toys (Play Lab).

variants.list: The four newest posts as wide guide cards (Play Lab).
